verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that an official Stripe CLI is documented at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli, and Connect is part of the Stripe platform, so the vendor does ship an official CLI. The pack contains only that single existence probe, with no detail on what the CLI does for Connect or for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: documented Connect-specific CLI commands (e.g., connected-account management, Connect webhook forwarding), any agent/AI-oriented CLI usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
